name: find-twitter-influencers
description: Fixed five-call, read-only Twitter/X influencer discovery bundle for one company and niche. Cross-checks brand context, curated web roundups, Twitter user search, and live topic chatter; it returns candidate evidence for agent-side deduplication and ranking without purchasing contact data.

company.description: Company or brand name whose audience and partnership fit should guide influencer ranking.

domain.description: Bare domain for the same company, e.g. acme.com.

webQuery.description: Web query for independent curated influencer roundups in the target niche, e.g. best fintech Twitter X creators to follow.

userQuery.description: Concise Twitter user-search keyword for relevant accounts, e.g. fintech payments.

tweetQuery.description: Twitter advanced-search query for current topical authors; supports X operators such as lang:en, min_faves:, since:, and hashtags.

steps.label: brand context by name — Apollo org search (MPP on Tempo)
brand context by domain — Company Enrich (MPP on Tempo)
curated influencer roundups — Exa search (MPP on Tempo)
candidate account search — SELAT Twitter user search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
current niche authors — SELAT Twitter advanced search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
